title: Standards That
Define Our Care
hero.text: Our care is guided by internationally recognised standards that ensure safety, consistency, and measurable clinical outcomes.

intro.heading: Internationally Recognised. Clinically Verified.
intro.text: Cambridge Hospital’s accreditations and certifications reflect externally assessed standards for quality, safety and clinical practice. They are subject to formal assessment and, where applicable, periodic renewal, helping to ensure that established international standards are consistently applied across our facilities, services and care pathways.

blocks.text: The Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF) is an international accrediting body for health and human services and is considered the international benchmark for rehabilitation services. CARF accreditation confirms that Cambridge Hospital’s rehabilitation programmes meet internationally recognised standards for patient outcomes, clinical processes and service delivery.

Cambridge Hospital’s facilities are accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI), an internationally recognised benchmark for healthcare quality and patient safety.

JCI accreditation reflects compliance with internationally recognised standards covering patient safety and clinical risk management, quality improvement and governance, infection prevention and control, medication management and continuity and coordination of care.
Accredited facilities: Abu Dhabi – Al Ain – Al Mudeef – Dhahran – Khobar - Jeddah

In Saudi Arabia, Cambridge Hospital’s facilities are accredited by the Saudi Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions (CBAHI), the national accreditation authority for healthcare institutions.
CBAHI accreditation ensures compliance with Saudi national healthcare standards relating to the safety, quality, and effectiveness of healthcare across our facilities in Saudi Arabia.
Accredited facilities: Dhahran – Khobar – Jeddah
Cambridge Hospital’s laboratory services are accredited by the College of American Pathologists (CAP), an internationally recognised authority in laboratory quality and diagnostic accuracy.

CAP accreditation underpins reliable diagnostic results through compliance with recognised laboratory standards and best practices for testing and reporting. This contributes to accurate diagnosis and patient safety through dependable diagnostics.
Accredited facility: Jeddah
Cambridge Hospital is affiliated with the Kozyavkin Method Group, an internationally recognised provider of intensive rehabilitation for children with cerebral palsy and neurological conditions.

The affiliation strengthens our paediatric rehabilitation programmes through internationally recognised therapeutic approaches focused on neuromotor development, functional mobility, physical participation and long-term quality of life, delivered within a multidisciplinary framework.
Affiliated facilities: Abu Dhabi – Al Ain – Dhahran

Cambridge Hospital is certified by the Abu Dhabi Occupational Safety and Health Centre (OSHAD), demonstrating compliance with occupational health and safety requirements and providing a safe environment for patients, team members, visitors, and contractors.
Certified facilities: Abu Dhabi – Al Ain – Al Mudeef

Cambridge Hospital is certified under the Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security Standard (ADHICS), reflecting compliance with requirements for healthcare information governance and cybersecurity.

These requirements cover the confidentiality of patient information, secure management of healthcare systems, protection against digital and cyber risks, and structured governance of information assets.
Certified facilities: Abu Dhabi – Al Ain

Cambridge Hospital participates in JAWDA, the Department of Health – Abu Dhabi program for healthcare quality performance and benchmarking. Participation reinforces transparent quality measurement, continuous performance improvement, accountability in care delivery, and benchmarking against system-wide standards.
Certified facilities: Abu Dhabi – Al Ain
